chunks.text: Northwind Demo Handbook. This synthetic document exists only to test the Docker scaffold.
The demo office opens at 09:00 and closes at 17:00 on weekdays.
Visitors must register at the front desk and wear a visitor badge at all times.
The demo cafeteria serves lunch between 12:00 and 14:00.
In case of a demo fire alarm, leave the building through the nearest marked exit.
Do not use the demo elevators during an alarm.
The assembly point is the blue bench in the demo courtyard.
Report to the demo safety officer once everyone is outside.
